title: MADGRAV: a multilevel anomaly-detection pipeline for gravitational-wave searches applied to LIGO data
abstract: arXiv:2609.39583v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present the results of \textbf{MADGRAV}, a deep-learning-based search for high-mass compact binary coalescences, applied to the data collected by the LIGO interferometers during the third observing run and during the first and second part of the fourth observing run. The \textbf{MADGRAV} pipeline consists of a series of sequential convolutional neural networks that perform anomaly detection, glitch classification, coherence testing, and signal ranking. Data from the Hanford and Livingston LIGO detectors are studied (both individually and in coherence) by way of 1 second Q-transform windows. Of the candidates that survive every stage of the pipeline, 48 reach the significance threshold, and we report 47 gravitational wave detections characterised by a false alarm rate below $1\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$ with a probability of astrophysical origin $p_{\rm astro}>0.9$. Of the 47 detections, 44 are shared with the minimally modelled coherent WaveBu

translated_title: MADGRAV：应用于LIGO数据的多层次异常检测引力波搜索流水线
translated_abstract: 我们展示了**MADGRAV**的结果，这是一种基于深度学习的高质量致密双星并合搜索方法，应用于LIGO干涉仪在第三次观测运行期间以及第四次观测运行第一部分和第二部分期间收集的数据。**MADGRAV**流水线由一系列顺序执行的卷积神经网络组成，用于执行异常检测、毛刺分类、相干性测试和信号排序。通过对1秒的Q变换窗口进行分析，研究了来自Hanford和Livingston LIGO探测器的数据（既单独分析也进行相干分析）。在通过流水线每个阶段的候选事件中，48个达到显著性阈值，我们报告了47个引力波探测结果，其特征为误报率低于1/年，且天体物理起源概率p_astro > 0.9。在这47个探测结果中，有44个与最小化模型的相干WaveBu（摘要截断）
tldr: MADGRAV是一种基于深度学习的多层次异常检测流水线，通过一系列卷积神经网络对LIGO数据进行异常检测、毛刺分类、相干性测试和信号排序，成功在观测数据中识别出47个高质量致密双星并合引力波事件，其误报率低于每年1次且天体物理起源概率超过0.9。
en_tdlr: MADGRAV is a deep-learning-based multilevel anomaly-detection pipeline that employs sequential convolutional neural networks for glitch classification, coherence testing, and signal ranking, successfully identifying 47 high-mass compact binary coalescence gravitational-wave detections in LIGO data with false alarm rates below 1 per year and astrophysical origin probability p_astro > 0.9.
